verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: the headline is on the left and the blue and dark info boxes sit side by side on the right, so it stays faithful to the original. Its flaws are that the body copy in both boxes is very small at 90 px tall, the headline sits on a busy photo, and the boxes are crammed against the right edge. B shrinks both info boxes to unreadable micro-text and pushes them into the bottom-left corner in reversed order (dark box before blue), which puts fine print in the lead spot, breaks the reading order and leaves the left side lopsided.
